openings.claim: The right-contact card can challenge whether removable edge guides carry lateral load independently of seal compression.
openings.delta: Replace tighter left-corner pressing with two removable rim-only guides using supplied strips, bolts and pads. Padded hatch-edge bearing carries sideways force; vertical lift-out releases the hatch. Cut/drill only strips; cord retains removed components clear of the full opening. Use the card as a diagnostic input to this proposed load path.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: retention from tighter left-corner pressing. If guides decouple lateral retention from vertical seating, the 1 mm card may change corner height while position remains within 1 mm under 20 N. Coupled retention predicts disturbance-associated slip or binding; its failure is not assumed. Ten-cycle position, pull resistance, reopening within 30 seconds and no new visible seal tears remain required; only disturbed seal-contact continuity is exempt.
openings.probe: First inspect rim capture, bolt reach, bearing engagement with 1 mm seating elevation, pad placement and lift-out clearance using supplied parts/ruler. Unknown geometry must establish reversible feasibility before testing. Allocate two pressing closure/pull trials, one disturbed, then ten guide trials following ten opening cycles, final closure disturbed: twelve total. Record marked position, corner heights, pull displacement, reopening time and seal condition. Card input passes through seating elevation to guide engagement; response is retained engagement or binding/slip. Compare final guide response with preceding undisturbed responses and the disturbed rival. Binding/slip triggers rejection of this assembly, not extra trials or deployment. Respect ninety-minute fabrication and twenty-minute observation limits.
assumptions: Rim geometry, bolt lengths, guide clearance, pad compression and strip capacity remain indispensable unknowns.

False/cancelling signals include guide migration, changing pad compression, inconsistent pressing or pull direction, and cumulative wear coinciding with final disturbance; one final disturbed trial cannot isolate these.
Defeat: lost engagement, extra seal compression needed, any outcome failure, forbidden alteration, obstruction, unrecoverable components, exhausted resources/time, or unresolvable causal ambiguity.

assessment: One uncertain probe; disturbance sensitivity informs load-path diagnosis without establishing reliable performance.

lineage.reason: Preserve separated lateral bearing in the disturbance probe.
